name: r-goose-note
description: R-Goose Note - 画布式笔记应用

scripts.kill:app: powershell -Command "Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'R-Goose Note.exe' -or $_.Name -eq 'electron.exe' -or $_.ExecutablePath -like 'E:\大师的\release\win-unpacked\*' -or $_.ExecutablePath -like 'E:\大师的\release-build*\win-unpacked\*' -or ($_.Name -eq 'electron.exe' -and $_.CommandLine -like '*E:\大师的*') } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }"
scripts.clean:release: powershell -Command "Get-ChildItem 'release-build*' -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (Test-Path 'release\builder-effective-config.yaml') { Remove-Item 'release\builder-effective-config.yaml' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }"
scripts.electron:build: npm run kill:app && vite build && powershell -Command "$out='release-build-' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'); node node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --projectDir . --config.directories.output=$out"
scripts.electron:build:mirror: npm run kill:app && vite build && powershell -Command "$env:ELECTRON_MIRROR='https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/'; $env:ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR='https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/'; Remove-Item Env:ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_CUSTOM_DIR -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $out='release-build-' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'); node node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --projectDir . --config.directories.output=$out"
